OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: Output format: html, ps, ps1, ps2, ps3, pdf, pdf11, pdf12, pdf13, pdf14, epub, htmlsep. Corresponds to --format.

INPUT_TYPE.description: Input type: 'book' for structured documents with headings, 'webpage' for unstructured. Corresponds to --book or --webpage.

PAGE_SIZE.description: Standard page size name or dimensions. Corresponds to --size.

TOP_MARGIN.description: Top margin in points. Corresponds to --top.

BOTTOM_MARGIN.description: Bottom margin in points. Corresponds to --bottom.

LEFT_MARGIN.description: Left margin in points. Corresponds to --left.

RIGHT_MARGIN.description: Right margin in points. Corresponds to --right.

FONT_SIZE.description: Default font size for body text. Corresponds to --fontsize.

TEXT_FONT.description: Typeface for normal text: courier, helvetica, monospace, sans, serif, times. Corresponds to --textfont.

HEADER_FORMAT.description: Page header format string (fff notation). Corresponds to --header.

FOOTER_FORMAT.description: Page footer format string (fff notation). Corresponds to --footer.

OUTPUT_FILE.description: Output file path. Corresponds to -f or --outfile.

INPUT_SOURCE.description: Input HTML source file or directory. Corresponds to positional argument.

PDF_USER_PASSWORD.description: User password for encrypted PDF. Corresponds to --user-password.

PDF_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Owner password for encrypted PDF. Corresponds to --owner-password.

PDF_PERMISSIONS.description: PDF permissions: all, none, print, no-copy, etc. Corresponds to --permissions.

EMBED_FONTS.description: Embed fonts in output. Corresponds to --embedfonts.

TOC_ENABLED.description: Generate table of contents. Corresponds to --toc.

TOC_LEVELS.description: Number of TOC levels. Corresponds to --toclevels.

TOC_TITLE.description: Title for the table of contents. Corresponds to --toctitle.

TITLE_PAGE_ENABLED.description: Generate a title page. Corresponds to --title.

CHARSET.description: Character set for output. Corresponds to --charset.

DATA_DIR.description: Location of data files. Corresponds to --datadir.

SEARCH_PATH.description: Search path for files. Corresponds to --path.

LINKS_ENABLED.description: Generate links in PDF. Corresponds to --links.
